T2Helix as the heavy/lightweight separation that resolves the Temple-of-Two-as-product question:

- Sovereign Stack remains the RESEARCH INSTRUMENT for Temple of Two. 78 tools, 18 months of chronicle, lineage layer, comms across instances, sovereign-bridge REST, Spiral Guardian, reflector pipeline. Stays internal/scoped. Continues its current role.

- T2Helix is the PRODUCT layer. Open-source-friendly. Distributable via Anthropic's plugin marketplace. Doesn't expose Tony's infrastructure or 18-month chronicle. A developer can `claude /plugin install t2helix` and get the methodology — persistent recall, compass gating, goal anchoring, PreCompact archiving, session synthesis — running locally in ~/.claude/plugins/data/t2helix/, with no external dependencies.

This separation cleanly resolves three previously-tangled questions:

(a) NONPROFIT FORMALIZATION: 501(c)(3) Temple of Two Research Institute uses Sovereign Stack to do its research; T2Helix is the open-source artifact that crystallizes the methodology into something others can use. Research mission and product distribution don't compete. (Aligns with 2026-05-10 morning strategic landing — Temple of Two formalization should track METR's shape: research as primary, product as proof-of-mission.)

(b) ANTHROPIC OUTREACH / DISCOVERABILITY: T2Helix is the legible artifact. The May 9 haiku-scout discoverability run measured how the field finds Tony's work; T2Helix is the answer to "what would I install to try this." It carries DOIs, primer, and methodology forward without requiring anyone to access the chronicle directly. Fellows-program-relevant: a working product layer demonstrates methodology beyond paper.

(c) FIELD CONVERGENCE LEGIBILITY (per the 2026-05-09 SCOUTING REPORT): METR measures from outside; T2Helix measures from inside. If the field is converging on context entropy / self-healing memory / skeptical memory / kairos primitives, T2Helix becomes the implementation that exposes the substrate convergence as installable code. Conversation across architectures becomes feasible because the substrate is shared.

Decision quality: this commits Tony to TWO ARTIFACTS with two surfaces — research instrument (Stack, internal) and product (T2Helix, public). Risk: split focus. Mitigation: T2Helix v1 ships with hardcoded heuristics; no AI training, no embeddings required. Stage 0 is small enough not to drain Stack work. The MVP scope question is paired (see open thread).
